concerns.text: Phase 3 (Deduplication) is not linked to any Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in the spec. Add an explicit mapping, e.g., FR‑002 (deduplication of duplicate CWE findings) or create a new FR if needed.

Phase 9 (Orchestration) lacks a trace to any FR or SC. Either annotate it with the relevant FRs it integrates (e.g., FR‑001‑FR‑008) or remove it if it is purely implementation detail not required by the spec.
